items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Arnold Ross, and Les Paul... and Shadow Wilson on drums. This was in 1945... Eddie Laguna. Remember him?

ctx.x: ...Arnold Ross, and Les Paul, who changed his name to Paul Leslie because he was under contract to somebody, and Shadow Wilson on drums. This was in 1945. One of the things was "These Foolish Things"... Ah, this was on the Sunset label. Eddie Laguna. Remember him?
Yes, of course. Eddie Laguna was my neighbor here in the Canyon.
